item.title: Cruising from Puerto Vallarta: what US and Canadian travelers should know about Mexico's first home port
item.description: Puerto Vallarta will become Mexico's first cruise home port, where voyages start and end. What's confirmed, what isn't, and how to plan a fly-and-cruise trip from the US or Canada.
